title: Abode | Marathon Village | Cozy, Urban, Local!
description:
Our Abode Home's offer our guests an unparalleled experience: design forward, clean, spacious, well-appointed “home-away-from-home” apartment with 5-star service, cleanliness, and communication.

• Luxury Decor by West Elm, CB2, Tuft & Needle, H&M
• Easy access to 100's of shops & restaurants
• Full Kitchen perfectly stocked for a chef's delight
• Convenient onsite parking on a first-come, first-served basis
• Our homes feature Tuft & Needle Queen Mattresses and West Elm Sleeper Sofas

The space
| Important to Note about Listings Photos|
We have multiple Abode’s at this property. Each one is designed to provide our guests a beautiful, clean, and comfortable place to stay. The photos will give you a sense of this building’s style. While your Abode may vary slightly, it will be just as well designed.

Just a 5-7 min Uber/Lyft from all the downtown hotspots! Or walk to Marathon Village and enjoy the Garage Coffee Co, Corsair Brewstillery, The Jack Daniels Store, American Pickers Antique Archaeology, and much more!

Your Abode is equipped with a smart TV or streaming device (Roku) which allows guests to access their own streaming accounts that are automatically logged out at checkout. Your Abode does not have cable or satellite service but the streaming device does provide some free TV and movie content.

Guest access
As a guest, you will have access to the following:

-Entire private apartment
-Gated on-site parking (first come-first serve)

Other things to note
| Other Things to Note Before Booking | 

| Same-Day Bookings | We work hard to make our homes available for same day booking for those guests in need. With that said, we require a 2-hour processing time from the point that your pre-arrival form is completed, to process and approve it, and provide access details. We ask that guests that are booking the same day refrain from arriving before completing the pre-arrival form and confirmation that their reservation has been approved for check-in.

| Locals | Due to restrictions placed on us by our landlord and as a condition pertaining to our ability to host, we are unable to accept reservations from guests local to the area (within 60 miles of the listing's city). By booking, you hereby accept and agree to this condition and that you'll be required to show proof of residency. Any reservation which does not comply with this restriction will be subject to cancellation. Please contact us if you're booking within your city.

| Representative Photos | We have multiple Abode’s at this property. Each one is designed to provide our guests a beautiful, clean, and comfortable place to stay. The photos will give you a sense of this building’s style. While your Abode may vary slightly, it will be just as well designed.

| Long Stay Cleaning Fees | 
Abode reserves the right to charge an additional cleaning fee when a stay exceeds 30 days. For each 30 days increment, an additional cleaning fee will be added to the stay.

| ID Verification + Credit Card Verification |
All guests are required to sign a separate rental agreement, and digitally provide ID prior to receiving access details. This information may be used for a basic public records search. Please see the "House Rules" section for complete details.

Additional credit card verification is required for bookings where the OTA does not handle guest payments directly. This specifically includes sending a photo of the card used for the booking and confirming a test charge before check-in can be approved. The name on the card must match the name on the reservation.

| Potential for Noise | You’ll be in an urban setting next to train tracks in addition to being in a residential apartment, which may be prone to noise from neighbors. We've included a pair of ear plugs and a white noise machine in case you need a little help getting a good night's sleep.

| Limited On-Site Parking | There is limited on-site parking. However, there is ample street parking available. Reminder to please lock your car and remove valuables - we are not responsible for theft or damage to your vehicle or its contents.

| Please See House Rules for important  guest rules before booking |
